column3: Manami Route · A Girl's Charm
Oh my, oh my... K-Kyou-chan's girlfriend...
No, that's totally not decided yet...?
B-But, when Kyou-chan becomes my boyfriend, it'll happen, right?
Isn't that obvious? But before that, why do I have to be your boyfriend?
What?! Calm down, take a deep breath...
Y-Y-You're right, y-yes!
You're not calm at all! Here, inhale--, exhale--
Hauuuu...!
You're not exhaling! It's not coming out!
B-B-B-Buuuut...
I'm begging you, please calm down, okay?
Even if you say that, this is so sudden, I don't know what to think!
Y-Yeah, I suppose you're right...
To be Kyou-chan's girlfriend...
...Hey, Manami～
Buuuhh...
It'd be troublesome for Kyou-chan, right...? To have me as a girlfriend...
...It's useless, she's completely fried.
I said, listen! Are you okay? Are you really okay?!
Whoa! I'm okay, totally fine! I'm fine... right?
Don't ask! It'll mess things up!
B-B-Because... I mean, that is, umm, umm...
Manami, look deep into my eyes.
O-Okay...
Ah... b-but I can't...!
Why's that?!
L-Looking that closely... It's like... I'm getting embarrassed!
What are you talking about? It's a face you've seen since we were kids. Here.
Hya...! No, as I said... That's, umm...
Don't look at my face like it's dirty!
I-I'm not looking at you like that!
But, you're so red... You're totally thinking that I'm embarrassing to look at, right?!
I'm saying that's not it～
A-Anyway! your face being so close is bad!
Then, should I go away?
T-That would also be a little... bad.
...Then what do you want me to do?
*sigh*... Okay, I understand. For now, let's calm down and regain our composure.
